purpose: Acquire and evaluate actual CMB power-spectrum/lensing likelihoods and DESI DR2 BAO for a joint late/early-universe measurement.
comparison: Replace only high-l Plik by TTTEEE_lite_native; this is foreground-marginalized CMB bandpowers, not a CMB distance prior.
theory: CAMB1.6.6 with PPF CPL dark energy, flat geometry, one0.06eV massive neutrino, Neff3.044, standard recombination/BBN helium. No user-added w+wa prior. IMPORTANT implementation-domain correction discovered during validation: analytic CAMB set_params rejects w+wa>0; baseline CMB inference therefore has an effective w+wa<=0 domain. Domain failures are not data exclusions and must be counted separately. This is not unrestricted CPL inference.
amendment: 2026-09-27: original no-extra-prior wording was incomplete about CAMB's implicit analytic-domain boundary. Preserved explicit correction before posterior interpretation; no active theory code or scientific likelihood changed.
